label: Whatever a GOD_4 with the classical…, from Whoever confirms a proposition by a sign… and 2 more
meaning: Divine veracity split in two: what a God with the classical attributes confirms by a sign he asserts; what he asserts he holds as known (he does not deceive); what he holds as known is true (he is not deceived). So whatever he confirms is true. Three open premises; each is needed (omission models in NAMING-VERACITY-BATCH1-CONTROLS).
